summary: Helport AI Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Geoffrey Bonnycastle as Chairman of the Audit Committee and Yu Pan as an independent director, effective May 12, 2026. Yu Pan brings extensive risk and modeling experience from U.S. Bank, Wells Fargo, and HSBC. No forced departure or abrupt change is indicated; the filing is a routine board committee assignment and director appointment. No deal terms, premiums, or consideratiolim are present. The event does not constitute a special situation beyond regular governance. Filing maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 disclosure.
